filesystem.description: Secure file system access within project directory.

github.description: GitHub repository operations including issues, PRs, and code search (GitHub's official MCP server).

memory.description: Persistent memory for maintaining context across sessions.

brave-search.description: Web search capabilities for finding documentation and examples (Brave's official MCP server).

playwright.description: Browser automation for testing and web scraping (Microsoft's Playwright MCP server).

installation: npx will download servers on first use
Some servers require API keys (see env sections)
filesystem: Replace /path/to/project with your actual project path
Only grants access within specified directory
github: Create GitHub token at: Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens
Token needs repo scope for private repositories
Uses GitHub's official MCP server via Docker; the archived @modelcontextprotocol/server-github is deprecated
GitHub also runs a hosted endpoint (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/) for clients that support remote servers
brave-search: Free tier available with rate limits
Replaces the archived @modelcontextprotocol/server-brave-search, which npm marks deprecated
playwright: Replaces the archived @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer, which npm marks deprecated
